texts: mixed: the question is asked correctly (Old Vesh as the teller, the reason left open), but the parse ties the story to the winter with an 'Of' link the instruction set licenses only for nominalizations and true relational nouns -- 'the story of X' is an aboutness phrase, which it explicitly excludes -- so a statement of the same fact would most likely leave that link out and this query would then match nothing. Put the aboutness on a verb, where it does have a licensed slot: "Why does Old Vesh tell the story that describes the bad winter of sixty-three years ago?"
